note: Every number quoted in the README, METHODOLOGY.md and the site is generated from here. Each figure carries the corpus, statistic, language, tokenizer and sample size it refers to, because the same language yields different numbers under different statistics and those have been conflated before.

median_fertility_bloom_vs_o200k.claim: A vocabulary allocated multilingually is not uniformly better. BLOOM's median across all languages is slightly worse than the current OpenAI encoding's.
median_fertility_bloom_vs_o200k.statistic: median over 204 languages of per-language fertility

bengali_bloom_vs_o200k.claim: Inside its coverage, the multilingual vocabulary is dramatically better. The advantage is scoped to the languages it targeted.

bloom_beats_o200k_count.claim: The coverage boundary is visible in the numbers.
bloom_beats_o200k_count.statistic: count of languages where BLOOM fertility < o200k fertility

telugu_median_tokens.text: 325 on gpt2, 208 on cl100k, 48 on o200k, 34 on bloom
telugu_median_tokens.claim: The same language costs wildly different amounts depending only on how much vocabulary was spent on it.

english_median_tokens.text: 25 on gpt2, 25 on cl100k, 24 on o200k, 25 on bloom
english_median_tokens.claim: The English baseline for the same sentences, on the same tokenizers.

telugu_floor_and_neglect.text: floor 34 tokens, 291 above it on GPT-2
telugu_floor_and_neglect.claim: Splitting the cost: the floor is what the writing system needs, the excess is vocabulary that was never allocated.
telugu_floor_and_neglect.statistic: min median tokens across the eight tokenizers, and the excess over it

telugu_glyphless_share.claim: Most of what the worst tokenizer charges for is not letters. It is byte fragments of characters it has no vocabulary for.
telugu_glyphless_share.statistic: share of tokens whose span contains no character

gpt2_over_thresholds.claim: The surcharge is the normal case, not an edge case.
gpt2_over_thresholds.statistic: count of languages above a fertility threshold

o200k_over_thresholds.claim: The surcharge is the normal case, not an edge case.
o200k_over_thresholds.statistic: count of languages above a fertility threshold

llama3_identical_to_cl100k.claim: Llama-3 extends cl100k_base by roughly 28,000 tokens. For these languages it reports fertility identical to cl100k to the last decimal, because none of those additions went to them. Falsifiable: add coverage for any of them and the number drops.
llama3_identical_to_cl100k.statistic: count of languages with fertility identical to cl100k

telugu_llama3_and_cl100k.claim: The clearest single instance of the negative space: two tokenizer generations apart, identical cost, because the newer vocabulary added nothing for this script.

cross_corpus_rank_correlation.claim: The ranking survives a change of register, so it is not an artefact of edited prose.
cross_corpus_rank_correlation.statistic: Spearman rho between FLORES-200 and MASSIVE fertility rankings
